devdoc.custom:security: Designed to prevent single points of failure and admin compromise
devdoc.details: Implements multi-admin governance with contract whitelisting and admin managementFeatures: 3-initial admin setup, democratic contract approval, admin penalization system

allowContract(address,string).custom:security: Only admin addresses can whitelist contractsRequires 2 admin approvals for activation (prevents single admin compromise)
allowContract(address,string).details: Implements democratic consensus - requires 2 admin approvals to activate contractPrevents duplicate approvals from same admin. Contract activates when approvals >= 2

params._contract: The address of the contract to whitelist

params._admin2: The address of the second administrator
params._admin3: The address of the third administrator
params._mainAdmin: The address of the main administrator

deleteContract(address).custom:security: Only admin addresses can remove contracts from the protocol
deleteContract(address).details: Only callable by admin addresses. Sets the contract's protocol status to false

params._contract: The address of the contract to remove from the protocol

params._admin: The address of the admin to query

returns._0: Admin struct containing status, penalties, and who penalized them
Array of all admin addresses in the system
True if the address is a protocol contract, false otherwise

penalizeAdmin(address).custom:security: Prevents self-penalization and duplicate penalties from same adminAdmin is removed when penalties >= 2 (majority consensus)
penalizeAdmin(address).details: Implements democratic consensus - admin is removed when majority agrees

params._admin: The address of the admin to penalize

proposeAdmin(address).custom:security: Prevents single compromised admin from adding unlimited adminsRequires democratic consensus (2 approvals) to add new admin
proposeAdmin(address).details: Uses same approval system as contracts - requires 2 admin approvals

params._admin: The address of the new admin to propose
